summary: End-to-end test of Fisher-Price Record Maker (FastAPI + React + MongoDB). Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass covering /api/convert happy path, non-MIDI 400, manual_offset path, STL binary download (model/stl, attachment), SCAD content (header, pin(, createDisc()), FPR 16+ lines of +/- (86 chars each) + title, list endpoint (no stl_b64/fpr/scad/_id leak, newest-first) and 404. Frontend: Page loads with RECORD MAKER header, empty-state 3D viewer with vintage image, Load MIDI zone, Settings (auto-transpose toggle on, capture window default 25s, thickness 3.0mm). Uploaded /app/tests/assets/sample_twinkle.mid through hidden input, clicked CUT THE RECORD, PRESSING RECORD loading overlay appeared, 3D red disc rendered in [data-testid=record-3d-canvas] (857x771px), download-stl/scad/fpr buttons visible with correct hrefs, SPEC SHEET + PLAYABLE TINES USED (G5 A5 B5 C6 D6 E6) displayed, and RECENT PRESSINGS listed 7 prior conversions with history-preview-* buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') (FastAPI). Migrate to lifespan context manager when convenient.
RecordViewer console warning: THREE.Clock deprecated (use THREE.Timer) and PCFSoftShadowMap removed (fallback to PCFShadowMap). Harmless but worth pinning three/@react-three/drei versions.
/api/convert stores base64 STL in Mongo; for large/long MIDIs this may bloat documents (16MB limit). Consider GridFS or filesystem storage.
No upload size limit on /api/convert — a malicious large file could stall the server (mesh boolean ops are CPU-heavy).
seed_data_creation: None. Existing MongoDB had prior conversions used for history list verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test file at /app/backend/tests/test_fisher_price_api.py uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Sample MIDI at /app/tests/assets/sample_twinkle.mid. All data-testids referenced in review_request exist. 3D canvas renders correctly in headless Chromium with WebGL.
